priorityClassName.description: PriorityClass name for Gatekeeper audit Pods. When unset, the upstream Gatekeeper chart default applies (system-cluster-critical). To use a different class, create the PriorityClass on the cluster first.

resources.description: Resource requests and limits for audit containers

auditChunkSize.description: Maximum number of results to return per audit page

auditFromCache.description: Enable auditing from OPA cache for improved performance. When true, audit runs evaluate cached data instead of making fresh API calls. Improves audit performance in large clusters but may miss recent resource changes.

constraintViolationsLimit.description: Limit number of reported violations per constraint

controllerManager.description: Configuration for Gatekeeper controller manager pods

priorityClassName.description: PriorityClass name for Gatekeeper controller-manager Pods (pod spec priorityClassName). When unset, the upstream Gatekeeper chart default applies (system-cluster-critical). To use a different class, create the PriorityClass on the cluster first.

resources.description: Resource requests and limits for controller manager containers

limits.description: Resource limits for controller manager containers

requests.description: Resource requests for controller manager containers

disableMutation.description: Disable mutating admission webhook functionality. When true, Gatekeeper will only perform validation (deny/allow) and skip any mutation policies. Useful for environments that only need policy enforcement without modification.

enableDeleteOperations.description: Enable policy evaluation for DELETE operations. When true, policies can evaluate and potentially block resource deletion attempts. Useful for preventing deletion of critical resources or enforcing cleanup policies.

enableExternalData.description: Enable External Data Provider support for policies to query external APIs during admission control. Required for advanced enterprise integrations with identity systems, vulnerability scanners, and compliance databases.

enableK8sNativeValidation.description: Enable Kubernetes native ValidatingAdmissionPolicy integration. When true, compatible policies are automatically converted to native K8s validation for improved performance. Complex policies fall back to webhook evaluation. Requires Kubernetes 1.30+ for full functionality.

enableRuntimeDefaultSeccompProfile.description: Enable RuntimeDefault seccomp profile for enhanced container security. Restricts system calls that containers can make, reducing attack surface and improving security posture. Required for SRP compliance.

externaldataProviderResponseCacheTTL.description: Cache duration for external data provider responses (e.g., "3m", "30s", "1h"). Higher values improve performance but may result in stale data. Must be a valid duration string with units (s=seconds, m=minutes, h=hours).

logLevel.description: Log level for the Gatekeeper controller and audit pods

mutatingWebhookTimeoutSeconds.description: Timeout in seconds for mutating admission webhook calls. Should be lower than validating webhook timeout for faster mutation processing.

nsLimitRange.description: Enable namespace level LimitRange definition for gatekeeper-system namespace

defaultLimits.description: Default resource limits for pods in gatekeeper-system namespace

defaultRequests.description: Default resource requests for pods in gatekeeper-system namespace

nsResourceQuota.description: Enable namespace level ResourceQuota for gatekeeper-system namespace

quotas.description: Resource quotas to enforce (empty/null values mean unlimited)

limits.description: Total resource limits across all pods in namespace

cpu.description: Total CPU limits limit (e.g., "8000m" for 8 CPUs)

requests.description: Total resource requests across all pods in namespace

cpu.description: Total CPU requests limit (e.g., "4000m" for 4 CPUs)

registry_secret_names.description: Names of Secrets in gatekeeper-system used as imagePullSecrets for pulling Gatekeeper images. When installed via the VKS AddonConfig framework, customizing this list automatically wires the new name(s) into every pod and Job spec. When installed via direct `vcf package install --values-file ...`, only the default name (`gatekeeper-reg-creds`) is wired through values/use-tag-values.yaml; using a custom name in this path additionally requires setting `image.pullSecrets` and the four hook-specific pullSecrets paths (`postInstall.labelNamespace.image.pullSecrets`, `postInstall.probeWebhook.image.pullSecrets`, `postUpgrade.labelNamespace.image.pullSecrets`, `preUninstall.deleteWebhookConfigurations.image.pullSecrets`) to match. Most customers should leave this at the default and instead populate the `gatekeeper-reg-creds` Secret on the cluster.

validatingWebhookTimeoutSeconds.description: Timeout in seconds for validating admission webhook calls. Higher values allow complex policies more time to evaluate but may impact cluster responsiveness.
